valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 non-GAAP EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027). USD primary listing, no ADR or FX conversion. FY2026 guidance $6.35-6.55 (midpoint $6.45) includes $0.60 of acquired IPRD charges; FY2027 consensus about $6.70 used as base.

bear.driver: Faster Eliquis/Opdivo loss of exclusivity erosion and pipeline setbacks (admilparant liver-safety questions)

base.driver: Growth portfolio offsets legacy erosion; FY2027 EPS near consensus

bull.driver: Pipeline wins (Cobenfy, milvexian, admilparant) and cost cuts lift EPS and the multiple

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $6.70 the $63.43 close implies 9.5x; the analyst-weighted target is not computable because no 12-month-horizon targets were documented.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $6.70 (about 10.6 pp)
valuation.watch_metric: Eliquis and Opdivo revenue erosion versus Cobenfy and Reblozyl growth, plus FY2027 EPS guidance

analyst_notes: Only a small subset of named post-Q3 calls was found. Targets span $40 (Morgan Stanley, Underweight) to $67 (BofA), with Wells Fargo cutting to $60 on loss-of-exclusivity concerns. The base case sits at the high end of the Hold cluster; the bear view implies EPS near $6.00 or a multiple below 8x. All horizons are undocumented so none enter the weighted target.
